versions.changelog: v2: Dimensional scoring (0-10), meta-skill optimization, progressive disclosure, autonomous setup

Two-phase skill improvement system: (1) structural audit against Anthropic best practices (gotchas section, trigger-phrase description, progressive disclosure, single focus), (2) Karpathy autoresearch loop — run skill, score outputs against yes/no checklist, make one change, keep if better, revert if worse, repeat to 95%. Includes checklist templates for outreach, content, research, and extraction skills. Based on Ole Lehmann's autoresearch method + Anthropic internal skill patterns.
